context: Debate prep meeting, morning, Government Building. Maria is stressed and focused.

nodes.text: Mr. John, we need to finalize your debate strategy. The journalists will be asking about your stance on women's issues.

moodVariations.Stressed: Mr. John, we're behind schedule. The debate strategy needs to be finalized. Now.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Hey Mr. John, got a minute? We should go over your debate strategy. You're going to be great.
moodVariations.Neutral: Mr. John, we need to finalize your debate strategy. The journalists will be asking about your stance on women's issues.

publicOptions.text: Yes, Maria. Let's go over the key points.
My late wife Margaret would have wanted me to fight for this. It's personal for me.
I know what I'm doing, Maria. Just handle the press.
You always keep me on track, Maria. I don't know what I'd do without you.
What are the journalists expecting? What's the angle here?

privateThoughts.text: She's hot when she's serious. That focused look... How do I pivot to asking her out?
She knows too much. If she ever talks, I'm done. Need to keep her close.
God, I'm lonely. Margaret's been gone three years. Maybe I need... companionship.
If I flatter her enough, she'll work even harder. Worth the effort.
Just get on with it. I have better things to do than debate prep.

nodes.text: Good. The key points are: equal pay, reproductive rights, and workplace harassment. You've been vocal on all three.

moodVariations.Stressed: Look, the key points: equal pay, reproductive rights, harassment. We're behind schedule.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Perfect. So, equal pay, reproductive rights, workplace harassment. You've been great on all three.
moodVariations.Neutral: Good. The key points are: equal pay, reproductive rights, and workplace harassment.

publicOptions.text: Those are the right issues. I'll emphasize them.
What about childcare policy? That affects working women too.

nodes.text: Alright, Mr. John. I think we're set for the debate. Good luck out there.

moodVariations.Stressed: We're done. Good luck at the debate.
moodVariations.Relaxed: I think that covers everything. You're going to do great, Mr. John.
moodVariations.Neutral: That concludes our prep session. Good luck at the debate.

publicOptions.text: Thanks, Maria. I'll see you at the press conference.
